message.content: Search the web for "VOXD linux voice input" - find the GitHub repository URL and installation instructions for VOXD, a Linux voice input tool. Look for its GitHub page and README. Return the GitHub URL, description, and detailed installation steps for Ubuntu/Debian systems.

content.text:
**GitHub URL:** https://project/src/file4

**Description:** Local, private, system-wide speech-to-text dictation for Linux. Press a hotkey → speak → text appears in your focused window. Built for tiling WM setups (i3/sway) — no GUI, no cloud, all local.

**Installation for Ubuntu/Debian:**

```bash
# 1. Install system dependencies
sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y socat xdotool dunst python3 python3-pip python3-venv

# 2. Ensure Python is 3.10–3.12 (faster-whisper doesn't support 3.13+)
python3 --version

# 3. Clone and install
git clone https://project/src/file5.git
cd voxd
chmod +x install.sh
./install.sh

# 4. Start the daemon
/project/src/file6.py &

# 5. Trigger dictation (CPU mode)
/project/src/file7.sh cpu
```

The installer auto-detects a compatible Python version, creates a venv at `/project/src/file8`, installs Python deps (faster-whisper, webrtcvad, sounddevice), copies scripts to `/project/src/file9`, and sets mic gain to 30%. For i3 integration, bind hotkeys in `/project/src/file10`.
